title: Shape & Restore Strong Hold Curl Cream
subtitle: 150gm
shortDesc: Long-lasting hold with hydration. Lock in defined curls in one step.
description: Shape and Restore Strong Hold Curl Cream is designed for all kinds of textured and curly hair. Lock in moisture and flaunt your well-defined curls with long lasting hold in just one step.
ingredients: Water, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Shea Butter, Argan Oil, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Panthenol, Aloe Vera Extract, Vitamin E, Coconut Oil, Fragrance.
howToUse: Apply a coin-sized amount evenly on soaking-wet hair. Distribute using a comb or your fingers. Gently scrunch upwards for curl definition and let it air dry. For stronger hold, pair with our hydrating curl gel.

faqs.q: Is it good for high porosity hair?
faqs.a: Yes, the rich emollients seal in moisture for high-porosity textures.

faqs.q: Will it weigh down fine curls?
faqs.a: Use a smaller coin-size amount for fine curls.

title: Enhance & Define Soft Hold Curl Cream
subtitle: 200gm
shortDesc: Soft, touchable curls with light hold. Ideal for waves and loose curls.
description: A featherlight curl cream that enhances wave pattern and softens texture without crunch. Perfect for 2A-3A hair types looking for definition without weight.
ingredients: Water, Glycerin, Shea Butter, Coconut Oil, Marula Oil, Panthenol, Aloe Vera, Hydrolyzed Silk Protein, Vitamin E, Natural Fragrance.
howToUse: Apply a coin-sized amount on dripping-wet hair. Rake through with fingers, scrunch upwards. Air dry or diffuse on low.

faqs.a: Soft hold gives natural movement. Strong hold gives long-lasting definition.
Yes, sulphate, silicone and paraben free.

title: Volumize & Define Hydrating Curl Gel
subtitle: 150gm
shortDesc: Crunch-free volume and shine. Hydrates while it holds.
description: Lightweight gel that gives bounce, volume and frizz control. Locks moisture in for shiny, springy curls.
ingredients: Aqua, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Glycerin, Polyquaternium-37, Flaxseed Extract, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Panthenol, Vitamin E, Fragrance.
howToUse: Apply on wet hair after cream. Rake through, then scrunch from ends upward. Let air dry. Scrunch out crunch (SOTC) once fully dry.

faqs.a: A soft cast that scrunches out cleanly.
Yes, cream first then gel for maximum hold + definition.

title: Frizz Control & Shine Hair Serum
subtitle: 50g
shortDesc: Smooth flyaways and add glass-like shine to dry curls.
description: A weightless, non-greasy serum that controls frizz and adds salon-like shine without buildup. Use on dry curls as a finisher.
ingredients: Cyclopentasiloxane, Dimethiconol, Argan Oil, Vitamin E, Camellia Seed Oil, Fragrance.
howToUse: Warm 2-3 drops between palms. Smooth over dry hair, focusing on ends and frizzy zones. Avoid roots.

faqs.a: Yes, a tiny amount is enough for daily smoothness.

title: Curl Cleanse Sulphate-Free Shampoo
subtitle: 200gm
shortDesc: Gentle, sulphate-free wash that respects your curl pattern.
description: A low-poo cleanser that lifts buildup without stripping moisture. Sulphate-free, silicone-free and CG-method friendly.
ingredients: Aqua, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Argan Oil, Aloe Vera, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Fragrance.
howToUse: Apply on wet scalp. Massage with fingertips for 60 seconds. Rinse. Follow with conditioner.

faqs.a: 1-2 times a week, or as needed.

title: Curl Quench Hydrating Conditioner
subtitle: 200gm
shortDesc: Deep moisture, easy slip, soft curls. Detangles in seconds.
description: Rich, slip-loaded conditioner that detangles, softens and hydrates. Can also be used as a leave-in for fine curls.
ingredients: Aqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride, Shea Butter, Argan Oil, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Panthenol, Aloe Vera, Vitamin E, Fragrance.
howToUse: After shampoo, apply mid-lengths to ends. Detangle with fingers or wide-tooth comb. Leave 3-5 minutes. Rinse with cool water.

faqs.a: Yes, a small amount can be left in on fine to medium hair.

title: Microfiber Hair Towel for Curls
subtitle: Frizz-free dry
shortDesc: Fast-drying, frizz-free, winter friendly microfiber wrap.
description: Ultra-absorbent microfiber towel that dries 3x faster than cotton and prevents frizz. Comes with a top loop and button to secure.
howToUse: After rinsing, gently squeeze sections then wrap towel turban-style. Leave for 10-15 minutes. Unwrap and style.

faqs.a: Yes, gentle cycle, no fabric softener.

title: Curl Protect Satin Bonnet
subtitle: Sleep cap
shortDesc: Protect your curls overnight. Reduce frizz, retain moisture.
description: Soft satin bonnet with adjustable ribbon. Reduces friction, locks in moisture and keeps curls defined while you sleep.
ingredients: Premium satin exterior, soft satin lining.
howToUse: Place bonnet over hair before bed. Adjust ribbon for snug fit. Sleep, wake, refresh.

faqs.a: Yes, adjustable ribbon fits most heads.

title: Detangling & Styling Brush
subtitle: Curl-safe
shortDesc: Flexible bristles that detangle without breakage.
description: Specially designed curl brush with flex-bristles that glide through tangles wet or dry, ideal for clumping curls during styling.
howToUse: Use on wet hair with conditioner. Brush in sections from ends to roots. Style as usual.

title: Satin Scrunchie Set
subtitle: 3 pack
shortDesc: No-crease satin scrunchies for soft tie-ups.
description: Soft satin scrunchies that hold curls without denting. Pack of 3.
howToUse: Tie hair gently into a pineapple at night to preserve curls.

title: Satin Pillowcase
subtitle: Curl-safe
shortDesc: Wake up with smoother hair and softer skin.
description: Premium satin pillowcase that reduces friction, frizz and breakage. Gentle on hair and skin.
howToUse: Slip onto your standard pillow. Sleep.

title: Hydrate Leave-in Curl Milk
subtitle: 150ml
shortDesc: Lightweight leave-in that hydrates and primes curls for styling.
description: A hydrating leave-in milk that detangles, moisturizes and preps curls for cream and gel. Adds slip without weight.
ingredients: Aqua, Glycerin, Coconut Oil, Aloe Vera, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Silk Protein, Vitamin E, Fragrance.
howToUse: Spray on damp hair. Distribute. Follow with cream and gel.
